model: YK-EP Centrifugal Chiller with EM or SSS Starter - OptiView E-Link (YorkTalk 3)
applies_to: YORK YK-EP (YKEP) centrifugal chillers with OptiView panel and electro-mechanical or solid-state starters, connected through a YORK E-Link gateway over YorkTalk 3.
summary: The E-Link gateway reads the YK-EP OptiView microboard over YorkTalk 3 and serves BACnet, N2, LON and Modbus objects in three sections. The EM/SSS sheet covers remote commands, water temperatures and pressures, motor currents, starter data and the operation, safety, cycling and warning codes.
notes: Every YorkTalk 3 E-Link sheet uses the same slot skeleton (P03 = AV 1 and so on); only the slots this chiller populates are listed, and slots marked not available on every program version are left out.
Object names are the E-Link names printed on the sheet; the sheet also gives LON, N2 and Modbus addresses, not reproduced here.
Access follows the sheet's Modbus function note: the remote slots AV 1-4 and BV 1-4 accept writes; the rest are read-only.
Status code objects (MV) use the code tables in the sheet; it notes that BACnet multistate values are the printed code + 1. Printed states are shown from 0.

source.title: YKEP OptiView BAS E-Link points list, tab YKEP EM or SSS

integration.summary: Put the chiller in remote/ISN control at the panel, then start and stop it with the E-Link remote run/stop object and write the remote setpoint and current limit. Read the operating, safety and warning codes, run status and water temperatures.

minimum_points.name: REM LEAVING CH LIQ TEMP SP
UNIT CONTROL SOURCE
minimum_points.why: Must read ISN (BAS) for BMS control

integration.enable: The E-Link remote slots (AV 1-4, BV 1-4) are the BMS commands; the chiller panel must be set for remote (ISN/BAS) control for them to take effect.
setup: The E-Link gateway talks to the chiller microboard over YorkTalk 3 and serves BACnet, N2, LON and Modbus; BACnet addressing is set on the E-Link.
Check the chiller program version against the sheet's version table; availability codes (S/O/N) are per version.
gotchas: Status codes are multistate values offset by 1 from the printed code tables.
Points marked optional (O) on the sheet report only on units with that option or program version.
